name: snowflake-mcp-server
title: Snowflake MCP Server
summary: Connect AI agents to governed Snowflake data and tools through Snowflake's managed Model Context Protocol server.
description: Snowflake's managed MCP server lets AI agents securely discover and invoke governed tools without separate server infrastructure. A server can expose Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst semantic views, Cortex Search services, controlled SQL execution, and custom functions or procedures. Access remains subject to Snowflake role-based access control. Customers authenticate with Snowflake OAuth using a preconfigured confidential OAuth security integration.

useCases.name: Governed data agents
useCases.description: Expose a Cortex Agent as a governed interface for business questions across its configured Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and custom tools.

useCases.name: Natural language analytics
useCases.description: Use Cortex Analyst semantic views and Cortex Search services to answer structured and unstructured data questions.

useCases.name: Controlled SQL and custom tools
useCases.description: Run permission-scoped SQL and invoke approved Snowflake functions or procedures through a standard MCP client.

snowflakeMcpOAuth.description: Snowflake OAuth authorization code flow using a preconfigured confidential client.
